newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's New Toyo offers 54 mln shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's New Toyo offers 54 mln shares in IPO.

text.p: Paper products and packaging materials maker New Toyo International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was offering 54 million shares at Singapore $0.80 each in its initial public offering.
Out of the total, 10.8 million shares will be placed out.
The public tranche of 43.2 million shares include 5.4 million shares reserved for staff and business associates.
The offer represents 25.1 percent of the company's enlarged share capital. The shares at S$0.80 cents each are offered at a historical price earnings ratio of 12.8 times.
The company will raise about S$40.2 million in net proceeds and the funds will be used to build a paper mill in Vietnam for toilet and facial tissue.
Part of the funds will be used to set up a corrugated carbon box plant and lamination plant in Myanmar.
Proceeds will also be used to finance a corrugated carbon box plant in China, and to acquire a 4.9 percent stake in Asia Food Products Pte Ltd, which operates noodles and snack factories in China.
Some funds will be used to repay bank borrowings and for working capital.
For the financial year ended December 31, 1996, New Toyo recorded a net profit of S$10.08 million on a turnover of 127.4 million.
The offer will close on April 2, and when issued trading is expected to start on April 4.
